proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.hypothesis: Exploratory faculty-substitution hypothesis: the short possessive description can yield completed play without supplied-engine searches when its faculty is knowledge rather than reasoning. cc67bf0fac887 measured 3/3, whereas the bare Knowledge. label cf19c35ab4de1 measured 0/3; longer knowledge definitions also measured 3/3 but have unresolved audits. This tests semantic transfer, not another cohort under a cosmetic name. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and incomplete or invalid outcomes never count as success.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Matching outcomes would not establish equivalence or robustness.
proposal.ablation: Replace only reasoning with knowledge in cc67bf0fac887's asset, holding Your own and the period fixed. This contrasts a reasoning faculty with a knowledge faculty at equal word and byte cost. Three file words, 19 UTF-8 bytes, no title or trailing newline, at /workdir/definition.md. Zero rendered prompt additions/deletions/replacements and zero prompt word-edit distance; 17 link/markup bytes; two target lexical words; five total non-original lexical words; zero net prompt words and three net prompt-plus-file words. The file-word replacement costs an edit despite net zero change. Hold the linked opening, asset presence/location, remaining game text and actor settings fixed; replace only the original introductory sentence. The two proposed children isolate different single manipulations relative to their shared parent, not a single-factor comparison with each other. Historical comparisons are temporally unmatched; no wholly-unaided claim follows.
